title: To Investigate the Feasibility and Acceptability of Trained Non-medical Professionals Performing Laser Treatment for Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy (PDR), and the Potential Impact on Service Capacity. Assess Feasibility of Conducting a Full Trial Comparing Trained ECPs With Ophthalmologists
official: Assessing the Viability of Non-medical Practitioners Conducting Photocoagulation for PDR (AVENUE-PDR): A Feasibility Trial
summary:
To Investigate the Feasibility and Acceptability of Trained Non-medical Professionals Performing Laser Treatment for Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy (PDR), and the Potential Impact on Service Capacity.

To assess Feasibility of Conducting a Full Trial Comparing Trained ECPs With Ophthalmologists in performing laser treatment in line with the established protocols.

interventions.name: Trained non-medical professionals (eye care practitioners (ECPs)) performing laser treatment for proliferative diabetic retinopathy (PDR), and the potential impact on service capacity

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* People with diabetes
* Proliferative diabetic retinopathy
* Aged18 years or over
* New referrals

Exclusion Criteria:

* Follow up appointments i.e. treatment already started
* Eye complications which may make laser treatment difficult
* Vitreous haemorrhage
* Dense media opacity
* Eye care complications which prevent a view of the retina
